conclusions: TensorLBM D2Q9 BGK achieves 4.33% error for Re=100 lid-driven cavity, passing the 5% validation criterion
High-Reynolds-number (Re=1000) simulations face stability challenges due to tau approaching 0.5
Recommendations for Re>500: finer grids, lower Mach numbers, MRT/cumulant collision, or LES models
